items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. It addresses 14 vulnerabilities, with 8 rated Critical, and some (CVE-2026-47988, CVE-2026-47984) require no authentication.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, which can lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) on May 25, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin fixes 15 CVEs in Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, and Magento Open Source. Key issues include Stored XSS (CVE-2026-34686) leading to arbitrary code execution and Path Traversal (CVE-2026-34653) allowing arbitrary file system writes.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files by disguising code as an image (polyglot). Adobe released Magento 2.4.9 with a fix, but older supported versions remained vulnerable initially.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and arbitrary code execution. It resolves 19 CVEs, with CVE-2026-21290 (Stored XSS) being one of the most severe.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce / SessionReaper, unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, named "SessionReaper" by Sansec, allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions. Adobe confirmed in-the-wild exploitation and changed its priority rating to 1.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe Commerce versions 2.4.9-alpha2 and earlier are affected by an Incorrect Authorization vulnerability. A low-privileged attacker could leverage this to access other user's data.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and arbitrary code execution. CVE-2025-47110, a stored XSS via server-side template injection, was specifically highlighted with an isolated patch.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves important and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and application denial-of-service. Adobe was not aware of any exploits in the wild at the time of release.

items.title: Adobe Security Bulletin
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, with successful exploitation potentially leading to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. Adobe was aware that CVE-2024-34102 had been exploited in the wild in limited attacks targeting Adobe Commerce merchants.
